# smallstep_workload (Data Source)

A workload binds credentials to a server process that consumes them (for example, NGINX reading a TLS cert and key).
It tells the Smallstep agent where the process expects its credentials and how to make the process reload them after they're renewed — via each credential's reload method (a signal or a systemd reload) and the workload's custom hook commands.
It only manages credential delivery, not the process itself.

Targeting (which devices a workload applies to) is determined by the policy of each referenced
credential, not by the workload itself.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "smallstep_workload" "nginx" {
  id = "7a2f6b48-9c31-4e0d-a5b7-3f8e1d604c95"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) A UUID identifying this workload. Read only.

### Read-Only

- `credentials` (Attributes List) The credentials this workload consumes. Each credential can have its own probes. The agent applies each credential's reload and probe configuration, along with the workload's hook configuration, when any of these credentials are signed or renewed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credentials))
- `hooks` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--hooks))
- `name` (String) A human-friendly display name for this workload.
- `reload_info` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--reload_info))
- `workload_type` (String) A free-form label describing the kind of process this workload runs. Used for display and grouping.
Common values include `nginx`, `redis`, `postgres`, `mysql`, `httpd`, `haproxy`, `etcd`, `kafka`, `zookeeper`, `git`, `grafana`, `nodejs`, `tomcat`, and `generic`.

<a id="nestedatt--credentials"></a>
### Nested Schema for `credentials`

Read-Only:

- `credential_id` (String) The UUID of the credential this workload consumes.
- `probes` (Attributes List) Health checks that the agent runs against this specific credential's endpoint. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credentials--probes))

<a id="nestedatt--credentials--probes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `credentials.probes`

Read-Only:

- `crt_file` (String) Path to the client certificate file to present during the health check (for mTLS). Optional.
- `key_file` (String) Path to the client key file to present during the health check (for mTLS). Required if `crtFile` is specified.
- `protocol` (String) The protocol to use for the health check. Allowed values: `TLS` `SSH`
- `root_file` (String) Path to the root CA certificate to validate the endpoint's certificate chain. Optional.
- `server_name` (String) The server name to use for SNI (Server Name Indication) when probing a TLS endpoint. Defaults to the hostname from `target` if not specified.
- `target` (String) The hostname and port (or IP and port) of the endpoint to probe, e.g., `app.local:443` or `127.0.0.1:8443`.



<a id="nestedatt--hooks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `hooks`

Read-Only:

- `renew` (Attributes) A list of commands to run before and after a certificate is granted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--hooks--renew))
- `sign` (Attributes) A list of commands to run before and after a certificate is granted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--hooks--sign))

<a id="nestedatt--hooks--renew"></a>
### Nested Schema for `hooks.renew`

Read-Only:

- `after` (List of String) List of commands to run after the operation.
- `before` (List of String) List of commands to run before the operation.
- `on_error` (List of String) List of commands to run when the operation fails.
- `shell` (String) The shell to use to execute the commands.


<a id="nestedatt--hooks--sign"></a>
### Nested Schema for `hooks.sign`

Read-Only:

- `after` (List of String) List of commands to run after the operation.
- `before` (List of String) List of commands to run before the operation.
- `on_error` (List of String) List of commands to run when the operation fails.
- `shell` (String) The shell to use to execute the commands.



<a id="nestedatt--reload_info"></a>
### Nested Schema for `reload_info`

Read-Only:

- `method` (String) Ways an endpoint can reload a certificate. `AUTOMATIC` means the process is able to detect and reload new certificates automatically. `CUSTOM` means a custom command must be run to trigger the workload to reload the certificates. `SIGNAL` will configure the agent to send a signal to the process in `pidFile`. `DBUS` will use the systemd system bus to issue a `try-reload-or-restart` job for unit specified by `unitName`. `PLATFORM` uses a method specific to the operating system. Allowed values: `AUTOMATIC` `CUSTOM` `SIGNAL` `DBUS` `PLATFORM`
- `pid_file` (String) File that holds the pid of the process to signal. Required when method is SIGNAL.
- `signal` (Number) The signal to send to a process when a certificate should be reloaded. Required when method is SIGNAL.
- `unit_name` (String) The systemd unit name to reload when a certificate should be reloaded. Required when method is DBUS.
